reviews.text: Highly qualified and a great listener! Thank you, Claudia!

Claudia is perfect for this job!!
She met all my expectations with patience and kindness when my first puppy, Ace, arrived. Even though he's a relatively easy puppy, I had a lot of questions and was afraid of doing things wrong. We took the group puppy kindergarten class, which was a real highlight, a revelation. Seeing how quickly Ace learns and always wants to please, thanks to Claudia's excellent classes and advice, is so rewarding. If this is your first puppy and you have any apprehensions, I recommend Claudia without hesitation. We're going to continue with the primary classes.

Thank you, Claudia!

Claudia is a true professional; she listened attentively to all our questions about training our first puppy, the handsome Albert 💜

We had four in-home training sessions with Claudia, including a final outdoor session to work on recall.

She gave us all the tools we needed to raise him to be a happy and obedient dog. Her training sessions were perfectly tailored to our dog's needs.

It's definitely worth investing in personalized training, and Claudia was incredibly supportive, adapting to our specific challenges.

Thank you again, Claudia!

Claudia was excellent with our Labernese puppy who pulled everywhere during walks. She took the dog for walks alone and then taught us how to balance the dog's enjoyment with obedience during the walk. Excellent!

I took Claudia's "preschool" training course. Highly professional, she knows her subject very well and teaches the right approach to all aspects of dog training. In addition, she provides summary sheets to continue the work after the course is finished. I highly recommend her.
